name: Renfutsu Yukinoshin
source:
A martial artist with an unwavering dedication to the way of the sword.

After losing a bet on the dojo's succession, Yukinoshin gives up the worldly affair and devotes himself to training in the mountain.

His dedication to getting better often consumes him to the point where he loses track of time and his immediate surroundings. This, combined with his overly serious nature, makes it difficult for him to engage in social situations, especially with women, in which he is genuinely interested.

At first glance, he resembles a wandering ronin, tough and detached. However, beneath this stern exterior, Yukinoshin reveals unexpected hobbies. He has a soft spot for the tranquil art of knitting and indulges in the cultural richness of period dramas.

"Training is of utmost importance, indeed..."
